newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Bangchak awards just one Oman cargo, at about +10.
newsitem.headline: Bangchak awards just one Oman cargo, at about +10.

text.p: Bangchak Petroleum Plc has awarded one 500,000-barrel cargo of Oman crude oil in its March purchase tender, industry sources said on Friday.
The cargo was awarded to a Japanese trader around MPM +10 cents per barrel.
Traders said the actual price paid was around MPM +11 to MPM +12 cents per barrel, but credit arrangements reduced the effective price to around MPM +10 cents.
Bangchak did not award any other crudes in the tender, which covered both Middle East and light sweet regional grades.
A refinery source said the company was holding negotiations to buy a Malaysian Tapis cargo, but felt the offer into the tender of quotes plus $1.40 had been too high.
Bangchak received offers of four Oman cargoes in the tender, the sources said.
